optional: 1 tsp garlic powder + 1 tsp onion powder, if you have it!

method: Add butter to a pan then add in your garlic and let it simmer for a few minutes

One Pot Mac & Cheese
one pot recipe | easy | 20 minute recipe | family cooking | meal prep friendly 

SAVE this recipe to make soon and FOLLOW @ellasrecipebook_ for more :) 

Nutrition: 
C: 46 | F: 22 | P: 16
Calories: 415 per serve
Makes 5 controlled portions 

Ingredients
45 grams butter
5-6 cloves of garlic, minced
35 grams maida
2 cups milk, slightly heated ( helps prevent lumps ) 
1 tbsp oregano
1 tsp black pepper
3 1/2 cups water
3 cups macaroni (220 grams), uncooked
160 grams cheese, mix of mozarella, cheddar
salt 
optional: 1 tsp garlic powder + 1 tsp onion powder, if you have it! 

optional2: cajun spice seasoning (game changer)

Method 
add butter to a pan then add in your garlic and let it simmer for a few minutes 
add in the maida and let it cook with the butter for a few minutes
whisk in the milk gently then add in the water, macroni, oregano, chilli flakes and salt and stir
leave it to cook for 10 - 12 minutes depending on how long your pasta takes to cook well  stirring every few minutes so nothing sticks then add in the grated cheese, check your salt and add pepper as well

pro tip: 
-add as much cheese as you like, the amount mentioned is a decent amount but to make it extra cheesy, it will need another 100 grams of cheese
-on the side, you can saute any veges you like and add them in once the pasta is cooked ( i love using capsicum, carrots, peas, zucchini )
-reheating: the sauce thickens alot as it cools so add in extra milk when reheating
